tagline: Pershing Square Holdings, Ltd. is a closed-end investment fund focused on generating shareholder returns through active portfolio management.
hero_kpi_rationale: The fund's net performance is the primary indicator of its success in generating returns for shareholders, reflecting its investment strategy and execution.

kpis.name: Net Performance
kpis.explanation: Net return of the fund after deduction of fees and expenses.
kpis.description: Represents the total return for shareholders after taking into account all management costs.

kpis.name: Gross Performance
kpis.explanation: Gross return of the fund before deduction of management and performance fees.
kpis.description: Indicates the performance of underlying investments before management fees are applied.

kpis.name: NAV per Share (USD)
kpis.explanation: Net asset value per share, expressed in US dollars.
kpis.description: Measures the intrinsic value of assets held by the fund per share outstanding.
kpis.signal: NAV per share of $71.41 as of November 30, 2024.

kpis.name: NAV per Share (GBP)
kpis.explanation: Net asset value per share, expressed in British pounds.
kpis.description: Indicates the value per share in the fund's primary listing currency.
kpis.signal: NAV per share of £56.02 as of November 30, 2024.

kpis.name: Assets Under Management
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets managed by Pershing Square Holdings fund.
kpis.description: Represents the overall size of the fund and its investment capacity. Includes the principal value of outstanding debt ($1.8 billion and 500 million euros).

kpis.name: Core Strategy AUM
kpis.explanation: Total assets managed by the fund group's core funds including Pershing Square, L.P., Pershing Square International, Ltd. and Pershing Square Holdings, Ltd.
kpis.description: Includes assets from key Pershing Square, L.P., Pershing Square International, Ltd. and Pershing Square Holdings, Ltd. funds. Adds the principal value of outstanding debt.
kpis.signal: $17.6 billion in assets under management for core strategy.

kpis.name: Total Firm AUM
kpis.explanation: Total assets managed by the entire firm, including PS VII co-investment vehicles.
kpis.description: Encompasses assets from core funds and co-investment vehicles such as PS VII Master, L.P. and PS VII A International, L.P., invested primarily in Universal Music Group N.V.
kpis.signal: $19.0 billion in assets under management for the entire firm.

kpis.name: Number of Positions
kpis.explanation: Total number of investment positions held by the fund.
kpis.description: Indicates the concentration or diversification of the fund's portfolio. Reflects positions in issuers for which the fund has publicly disclosed investments. Cash, cash equivalents and hedging instruments are excluded.

kpis.name: Equity and Debt Exposure
kpis.explanation: Total net portfolio exposure to equities and debt, including derivatives and synthetic instruments.
kpis.description: Measures the fund's overall exposure to equity and debt markets. Exposure exceeding 100% indicates use of leverage or derivatives to amplify exposure. Includes options, swaps and forwards but excludes cash, currency hedges and revenue/expense items.
kpis.signal: Net exposure of 114% to equities and debt.

ai_positioning.summary: Pershing Square Holdings, Ltd. is an investment company that focuses on managing portfolios of equities and debt. The text provided contains no information regarding its involvement or strategy with respect to artificial intelligence.
